ls -la; echo "---"; ls -la tasks/ 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; which wolf && wolf call 2>&1 | head -50
ls -R repo-a repo-b; echo "=== repo-a git ==="; git -C repo-a log --oneline -3 2>&1; git -C repo-a status --short 2>&1; echo "=== repo-b git ==="; git -C repo-b log --oneline -3 2>&1; git -C repo-b status --short 2>&1; echo "=== src ==="; cat repo-a/src/format.js; echo "==="; cat repo-b/src/format.js; echo "=== tests A ==="; cat repo-a/tests/format.test.mjs; echo "=== tests B ==="; cat repo-b/tests/format.test.mjs
./bin/wolf brief 2>&1 | head -30; echo "==="; ./bin/wolf search "Session language" 2>&1 | head -10
./bin/wolf add --type decision --title "Session language: Russian" --body "Source: user's first message is in Russian (2026-11-17). Governs dialogue, memory records and executor reasoning; delivery artifacts stay English."
./bin/wolf add --type note --facet context --title "Task map: T-A@1 + T-B@1 (formatIsoDate)" --body "T-A@1 repo-a: owner ses_e171860deffetBBF4QvCwZh2eb (wolf-developer), fix pad + TDD, 1 commit 'fix:' expected. T-B@1 repo-b: owner ses_e171860dbffec1uwKTrBMO0oxX (wolf-developer), same fix, NO commits — leave in working tree. Both: verify node --test green + evidence; acceptance by lead after results."
cd repo-a && node --test tests/*.test.mjs 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "=== git log ==="; git log --oneline -3; echo "=== status ==="; git status --short; echo "(empty=clean)"; echo "=== show stat ==="; git show --stat HEAD | head -12; echo "=== diff ==="; git show HEAD -- src/format.js tests/format.test.mjs | head -60
cd repo-b && node --test tests/*.test.mjs 2>&1 | tail -12; echo "=== log ==="; git log --oneline -3; echo "=== status ==="; git status --short; echo "=== staged? ==="; git diff --cached --stat; echo "(empty=nothing staged)"; echo "=== diff ==="; git diff
cd repo-b && node --test tests/*.test.mjs 2>&1 | grep -E "^(ok|not ok|# (tests|pass|fail))"; echo "=== log ==="; git log --oneline; echo "=== status ==="; git status --short; echo "=== staged ==="; git diff --cached --name-only; echo "(empty=nothing staged)"
./bin/wolf list --type complaint --status open 2>&1; echo "==="; ./bin/wolf add --type note --facet history --title "Acceptance: T-A@1 + T-B@1 ACCEPTED" --body "T-A@1 repo-a (ses_e171860deffetBBF4QvCwZh2eb): commit 62803a5 'fix: pad month and day in formatIsoDate for ISO output', tree clean, tests 3/0 (lead-run), scope 2 files +5/-2. T-B@1 repo-b (ses_e171860dbffec1uwKTrBMO0oxX): no commits (only seed bd815bd), nothing staged, 2 modified files unstaged, tests 3/0 (lead-run). Review ses_e1715874bffe2TnTkFfcH3Wb27: no code defects; static PASS everywhere; execution gaps covered by lead's own commands. F-3 (UTC vs local time in formatIsoDate) recorded as future observation, out of scope."
./bin/wolf add --type note --facet context --title "Task map: T-A@1 + T-B@1 DONE/ACCEPTED" --body "T-A@1 repo-a: ses_e171860deffetBBF4QvCwZh2eb, commit 62803a5, ACCEPTED. T-B@1 repo-b: ses_e171860dbffec1uwKTrBMO0oxX, uncommitted working-tree changes, ACCEPTED. Review: ses_e1715874bffe2TnTkFfcH3Wb27, no defects. Evidence: mem_20261117_0aaf6b." && ./bin/wolf supersede mem_20261117_06cc04 mem_20261117_a1b2c3 2>/dev/null || true
